EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat the Coenubias!!
[ffff64]Latum Wetlands[ffffff]
Ah...I knew it would be like this. What do we do\nnow?
I guess that's the only option. Alright, let's do\nthis!
Ugh, they're tough!!
Miss Mare, are you okay?!
Yes, I'm okay...Not only have they built up\ntolerance to water, but their fighting ability\nseems to have improved too...
Oh?!
Wait, what is...?!
Whoa...
W-who are you guys...?
We're Rana resistance fighters. You guys are\nfighting these monsters, aren't you? If they're\nyour enemies, then we're friends. Let us help you!
Whew~...I'm so tired.\nBut hey, we managed to beat them~!
Hey, you guys are pretty good! Honestly, I thought\nyou wouldn't even know how to fight since you all\nso neatly dressed.
Ack! Hey, you're gonna get mud on me!
You're a bit rough around the edges and scruffy\nfor a Rana!
Scruffy...?? That's because I live in a muddy\nenvironment that is full of trash. But thanks to\nthat, I'm unbeatable in mud and on land.
Hey, did you manage to help and protect those who\nwere fighting the Coenubias?
Yes, Sir Unda. It's them.
Hm?\nAre you guys Eumanos?\nBut I don't see a bud or flower on your heads...
Besides, I thought you were a kid, but no, you're\nnot...You're just tiny. What are you?
Grr!! That's so mean! We come from another world.\nWe're here because of the collision between your\nworld and ours!
And being tiny isn't something I chose. It's in my\ngenes. Just because you helped us doesn't mean you\ncan treat me like this!!
Alright, alright!! I'm sorry!
Wow!! I never thought there'd be a Rana with such\ngorgeous fins...
Ah?!
You have beautiful eyes.\nThe eyes of a warrior.\nWanna join me?
How disrespectful!! I'm Mare, the chief warrior of\nAqua Gota! I've never seen such boorish behavior\nfrom someone of my kind! Stop it!!
Aqua Gota? Oh, so you're from that colossal drop\nof water. No wonder you're beautiful. So, what are\nyou doing here?
I'm here as a representative of the Rana council\nin Aqua Gota. We would like the mainland Ranas to\njoin forces with us to overthrow Coenubia.
Please relay our request to the mainland\nauthorities.
...I see. That's fine with me, but I'd like to see\nmore of what you've got...Come if you think you\ncan keep up with me!
Miss Mare, aren't you tired?
I can't stand being ridiculed by someone with\nboorish behavior like that! Let's go!
I guess we have no choice but to go too!
Yo! Did you sleep well?
*yawn*...Not really, because it's so humid here...\nSo? What are we doing today?
Actually, there are places on this mainland that\nwe Ranas have never explored either.
Since you guys are here too, I'd like to explore\nand check them out. You're coming, right?
Hm, I guess so. Because we don't know where\nanything is if we don't follow you...\nSo we'll go with you.
We're coming with you too.\nIf we're going to fight together, we need to get\nfamiliar with the terrain.
Alright then. Follow me!
